messages:
zoe-marketing: Hey team — planning a compact community launch: a short OSS refapp + 15m webinar + a bench highlight. Working name: "QuickStart Refapp". Goal: launch post, two short tutorials, webinar, and inbound routing. Target week: June 10. Need owners.

sam-devrel: I can do the tutorials and the repo. Plan: `tutorials/quickstart` (10 min) and `tutorials/advanced` (15 min). Include Docker and a Cloud Run example.

kai-eng: I'll run a small reproducible bench across modes. Quick command: `./bench.sh --model redwood/open-7b --seq 256 --concurrency 4 --out bench/quickstart.json`. Will report p50/p95 and cost/1k tokens.

priya-product: For the narrative: short decision bullets (Hosted = easiest, Dedicated = predictable, Private = compliance). I can draft the hero blurb.

maya-ops: HubSpot: will create form `quickstart_refapp_jun` with hidden `campaign=quickstart_jun` and `interest=refapp`. Routing: small companies -> SDRs, otherwise -> AE. Also add webhook to `/integrations/marketing/inbound`.

sam-devrel: Repo env snippet for README: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<REDACTED>"
export REDWOOD_MODEL="redwood/open-7b"
./run_demo.sh`. Will add TROUBLESHOOTING.md.

zoe-marketing: Webinar format: 15m demo (sam), 5m bench highlights (kai), 10m Q&A. Record and clip a 60s quickstart video for socials.

kai-eng: I'll include a short `bench/README.md` explaining variance and instance types. Will paste the headline stat here once runs finish.

zoe-marketing: Actions: 1) @sam-devrel repo by May 25, 2) @kai-eng bench by May 27, 3) @priya-product copy by May 23, 4) @maya-ops HubSpot by June 1, 5) marketing draft post by June 3. I'll add to board and send invites. :rocket:
